limitations: Thirty sequential samples are one stochastic run, not a confidence interval.
Task-main was measured with a persistent CLI start plus explicit resume after the native completion receipt because -z is intentionally stateless and terminal_background-ineligible.
Raw session IDs and task IDs are authoritative in Hermes state.db and aota-runtime; this evidence stores bounded identifiers and aggregate metrics, not prompts or secrets.
